requirements_summary:
- Workload: low-latency chat plus high-volume embedding generation and reranking for personalization.
- Latency targets: p95 chat < 120ms; p50 < 50ms.
- Throughput: steady 200 qps embeddings at peak window, daily spikes up to 600 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market:. want to control monthly run-rate, prefer committed discount vs on-demand.
- Model preferences: open/model variants (LLama3-like family preferred), Redwood-curated models acceptable if performance parity.
- Routing/fallback: primary Dedicated -> fallback to hosted-compatible variant in another region for capacity incidents.
- Observability: token-level cost + latency breakdown required in Console.
- Data controls: VPC, KMS, retention policy 90 days for logs, per-customer data filters.
commercial_terms_discussed:
- Baseline commit: proposed 3,500 GPU-hours/month equivalent (baseline cluster ~3 x A10-equivalents).
- Burst pool: +50% burst capacity available for short windows, billed at agreed burst rate.
- Overage: capped at 1.5x committed unit price for billing beyond burst; team asked for monthly overage cap.
- Ramp schedule: 3-month ramp to full commit (month1 billed at 50% commit, month2 at 75%, month3 full) — Catalpa requested this in writing.
- Contract length: negotiating 12-month term with mutual exit on material SLA breach.
- Credits: trial credit for first 30 days of Dedicated to cover migration stabilization.
- Volume discount tiers: discussed stepped discounts at 6k and 12k GPU-hours per month.
- Payment terms: Net30; CFO pushing for Net45 but preferred Net30 by Redwood.
- Support: Standard included; premium SRE hours add-on quoted separately.
pricing_concerns_and_asks:
- Catalpa wants clearer definition of 'GPU-hour equivalent' and headroom for model upgrades.
- Asks for explicit guarantee on p95 latency for chat or defined credit schedule.
- Wants burst pricing to be predictable (not surprise spike bills) — proposing monthly overage cap and a buffer of prepaid burst credits.
- Requests a ramp credit structure (50/75/100) to soften first-quarter impact on ARR recognition.
- Legal needs standard DPA + SOC2 attestation; pen-test window required before Prod cutover.
- SE asks: include KV cache warmup guidance and recommended autoscaler config to avoid cold-start spikes.
